text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Opera O, today is your birthday, isn't 
it? Happy birthday."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it is a great honor to receive 
birthday wishes from Hayahide-san, but... 
hmm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What is it? On such a joyous, celebratory 
day, has something happened?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I prepared an opera stage precisely to 
celebrate that memorable day, and yet...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so dazzled by my brilliance as 
the leading star that they can barely even 
look at me straight!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying customers aren't showing 
up. Well, I can understand why it ended up 
that way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You perform frequently regardless of 
whether it's your birthday, so they likely 
assumed this was simply one of those 
occasions.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh. My stage performance is always 
top-notch, but perhaps I failed to convey 
just how special today's show truly was...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then let the two of us hatch a 
scheme! A bold and ambitious plan to 
announce to all the opening of this 
special stage!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Did I just say something terribly 
unnecessary?
